CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS

  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Rodeo Drive/Special Events/Holiday Program
  Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Wednesday, January 31, 2024
  5:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  January 31, 2024 / 5:02 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Vice Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Lili Bosse, Deputy City
  Manager Keith Sterling, Community Outreach Manager Magdalena Davis

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Rodeo Drive Committee Partnership with Mr. Brainwash for Public Art Display, “Life
  is Beautiful,” February – June 2024:
  a. Presentation by Magdalena Davis:
  i. This is the second partnership with Mr. Brainwash, with the first occurring
  last summer.
  ii. The art installations would be up from February to June 2024.
  iii. There is no financial ask from the city as Mr. Brainwash and the RDC have
  agreed to cover all installation, maintenance, and removal costs.
  iv. Mr. Brainwash and the RDC have asked for a waiver of the $2,743 permit
  fees.
  v. The Chamber, CVB, and RDC have committed to cross promotion of the
  instillations.
  vi. The art would consist of twelve heart ballon sculptures and quote decals.
  vii. The quote decals will accompany the sculptures and will be on sidewalk
  decals which will be weather safe and secure.
  viii. The bases of the sculpture are 4’ x 4’ cubes and the balloons are 5 feet tall,
  meaning the sculpture has an overall height of 9 feet, with the exception of
  the angled sculptures, which are between 8 and 9 feet.
  b. The sculptures will not be blocking any of the entrances to the buildings they are
  installed in front of.
  c. Both Vice Mayor Friedman, Councilmember Bosse feel that the sidewalk stencils
  will take away from the sculpture.
  d. Prior sidewalk decals were controversial among people who were asked.
  e. The Committee is fine with removing the sidewalk decals.
 Highlights for January 31, 2024
Rodeo Drive/Special Events/Holiday Program Committee

  f. During the installation of the structures, storeowners will be asked if they approve
  of the installation in front of their store, if they do not approve, the sculpture will be
  moved.
  g. When the measure is presented to council, staff will note that the liaison consensus
  was that the art be approved but not to include the sidewalk decals.

  3) Future Agenda Items:
  a. The Committee will next meet at a time to be determined to discuss Concourse
  d’Elegance.

  4) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: January 31, 2024 / 5:30 PM
